items.title: How Ryanair Built Europe's Most Profitable Airline By Making Flying As Uncomfortable As Possible
items.summary: The European short-haul aviation landscape has been conquered by a blue-and-yellow paradox that defies conventional corporate logic. An airline that routinely strips away basic cabin amenities, charges for hand luggage, and leaves passengers standing on cold tarmacs should be facing terminal commercial decline. Yet, Ryanair stands as an absolute financial titan, consistently outperforming legacy flag carriers that spend billions of dollars trying to pamper their client base.
